title: Southern Suite 4 miles from Broadway
description:
This quiet neighborhood will give you the peace of being in the country, while only 10 minutes from broadway. It is perfect for a family or groups of 4 looking to come explore our wonderful city! The unit is located on the lower level of our primary home, with a private entrance for your convenience! The WiFi and remote access passwords are delivered upon arrival! This cozy space, with Nashville theme, will give you a real feel for Tennessee and our city!

The space
Private Entrance two bedrooms and one bathroom lower level apartment! One large common space with electric fireplace and sectional! The bathroom includes all of your essentials towels, shampoo, conditioner, soap, and blow dryer ! The kitchen includes a full size fridge, microwave and keurig stocked with coffee. Please no partying as this is an extension of our primary residence! There will be a $20 early check in and or late checkout fee unless agreed upon prior to booking.

Guest access
Covered back patio parking and everything included in our lower unit home!

Other things to note
The home is undergoing renovations, and we try our best to keep the outside clean and tidy. However some building materials may be visible outside. We hope you enjoy your stay!
